libs.note: BH-1928. bin/lib/model-route.sh's model_routes_bundle (the route bundle bin/fly-pool.sh and bin/fly-dispatch.sh ship to a builder) reads this through lib_env_apply model-route. Not required: the lib keeps 15 as its documented fallback, and an env value that is not a positive integer is never used.

knobs.note: BH-1928. One total deadline for building the route bundle, across every build role. Each worker ask gets the smaller of MODEL_ROUTES_BUNDLE_TIMEOUT_S (4) and what is left; once it is spent the remaining roles are served from this box's cache and model-route.log says so. A healthy worker answers the 17 roles in about 5 s; without it a slow one added about 68 s to every pool tick.
